name: Lowrise Cargo Short — Woven Synth-Canvas
description: Low-rise cargo shorts in olive synth-canvas with two side cargo pockets secured by magnetic snap closure. Hem sits just above the knee with a raw-cut finish. Built for warm-weather market runs and Circuit bar patios — functional without being workwear.
functionality: Magnetic cargo pockets resist pickpocketing; synth-canvas dries fast after rain or lake spray.
what_it_says: You're practical and outdoorsy without committing to either identity fully.
story_hooks: Magnetic snap closures occasionally interfere with cheap BCI hardware — a known issue Rolen Depot refuses to acknowledge.
One of the cargo pocket linings has a hidden interior slit just large enough for a folded document or a slim blade.

physical_description.visual_profile: Casual, slightly streetwear-leaning silhouette with a relaxed but intentional cut. Low-rise design emphasizes hip mobility and urban leisure aesthetic. Raw-cut hem at knee creates an unfinished, contemporary look that reads as deliberate rather than worn-out.
physical_description.fit: Low-rise, relaxed through hip and thigh with a straight leg opening. Sits approximately 2-3 inches below natural waistline. Enough room in thigh for unrestricted movement, tapered slightly at knee without being slim.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-canvas — a lightweight petrochemical composite with cotton-weave simulation, treated for UV resistance and moisture-wicking in the heat-trapped urban environment of the GLMZ.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly structured fabric with subtle horizontal weave visible under direct light. Synth-canvas has a soft hand-feel despite industrial origin — breaks in quickly with wear, developing micro-creases that signal authenticity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted olive-green base with natural color variation typical of synth-weave production. No intentional patterns; variations in dye saturation suggest mid-tier manufacturing without excessive finishing.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures on both side cargo pockets — silent, reliable, resistant to sweat and salt spray from Great Lakes humidity. Likely belt-loop compatible waistband with friction-fit or standard button closure at fly.
distinctive_features: Two deep side cargo pockets with magnetic snap closures
Raw-cut knee-length hem — deliberately unfinished edge
Synth-canvas construction optimized for warm, humid regional climate
Rolen Depot branding — working-class apparel manufacturer, not luxury
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional — accessible to working-class residents, cost-conscious but quality-assured. Price point suggests Φ45-65 range.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street casual for Circuit district lounging, off-shift market runs, or casual outdoor movement. Worn by service workers, gig riders, and anyone prioritizing comfort in the heat. Not corporate, not salvage — deliberately casual.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after 2-3 wears; fabric softens and develops personalized creases. Magnetic snaps show minor oxidation after 6 months. Raw hem naturally frays slightly, adding character without degradation.
